data.gender_notes: Mukhallisah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khalasa' which means 'to hide' or 'conceal'. The name Mukhallisah can be interpreted as 'she who is veiled' or 'hidden'. In Islamic spiritual tradition, it can symbolize the inner, spiritual self that is often hidden from the outside world. The name Mukhallisah carries the meaning “Veiled, hidden, concealed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mukhallisah usually hope their child will grow to embody veiled, hidden, concealed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
